# NavigationAnnouncer

An invisible live region that speaks turn-by-turn guidance to assistive technology.

- **Import:** `import { NavigationAnnouncer } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Utilities
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; no Figma component by design.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/utilities-navigationannouncer--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import {
  AnalyticsProvider,
  NavigationAnnouncer,
  ThemeProvider,
} from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function NavigationAnnouncerExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <AnalyticsProvider>
        <div className="rounded-control border border-border bg-background p-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          <NavigationAnnouncer message="Proceed to gate A" isActive />
          <span aria-hidden="true">{"Proceed to gate A"}</span>
        </div>
      </AnalyticsProvider>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## NavigationAnnouncer

A structurally invisible primitive that pipes active wayfinding updates directly
into accessibility channels (VoiceOver, TalkBack) without altering layout DOM hierarchies.

Its props are `NavigationAnnouncerProps`.

- `message`: `string`, **required**.
- `isActive`: `boolean`, optional, default `true`.
